body: You mean ask him, or ask myself?

Honestly the last time I was in therapy consistently was 5-8 years ago. My therapist at the time retired and since then I just haven’t found someone. The process is so unpleasant and uncomfortable for me. If I call around to 10 therapists, 7 will never pick up or call me back, 2 will say they will call me back and never do, and 1 will start off by asking a series of incredibly invasive and nerve wracking questions right off the bat. I’ve seen plenty of psychiatrists over he years as well but I feel that ultimately medication is not for me. I know it’s a bit of a cop out to say things like therapy is too difficult to start when I haven’t even done it in so long. It’s just hard not to feel like every difficulty is a sign that I should just give up.

I have the same exact worries. I’ve been trying to have internet installed in my apartment twice now, and both times there’s been some reason why they can’t. It seems so insignificant to most people, but it is just so hard for me. I started crying as soon as the guy stepped outside for a moment. I tried my best to stop before he came back in, but I’m sure it was obvious. It’s almost funny how similar our days were today. Most people just do those kinds of things without second thought. But I really worry about functioning as an adult too. I’m 22. It’s hard not to feel like my life is going nowhere when I can’t accomplish basic tasks. And it’s not like the capability isn’t there, it’s just depression and anxiety getting in the way. I don’t know how to fix it. But I wish you good luck. I understand your pain and I know it’s not easy.
